provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Pole RA 205°, Dec 52° (obliquity 30°), fitted to coma anisotropy by Kim et al. (2020); the prime meridian and spin phase are arbitrary and the period is not determined.
provenance.qualification: Computed 2I/Borisov Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
